entries.title: Optical experiment demonstrates the strong Mpemba effect in a single qubit
entries.summary: Typically, after a physical system is disturbed, it can gradually return toward a state of thermal equilibrium by exchanging heat with its surroundings. Thermal equilibrium is a state in which there is no net transfer of heat between the system and its surroundings.

entries.title: Bound states in the continuum through quantum interference in ultracold atomic collisions
